meta.summary: Context pack for the Northwind Supply demo business database.

propose.text: Northwind Supply sales database: customers, orders, invoices and payments for a B2B distributor.

summary.text: Northwind Supply is a B2B distributor that sells products to customers through regional sales reps and invoices them on credit terms.

facts_told: Invoices are due 30 days after the invoice date.
Cancelled orders never count as revenue.
inferences: Regions probably map to sales territories.

propose.title: Term: Open invoice
propose.text: An invoice whose payments do not yet cover its amount.

propose.title: Term: SKU
propose.text: Stock keeping unit: the unique product code in products.sku.

propose.title: Term: Rep
propose.text: A sales representative from sales_reps.

propose.title: Term: DSO
propose.text: Days sales outstanding: average days from invoice to payment.

propose.title: Term: Backorder
propose.text: Ordered quantity not yet shipped.

propose.title: Term: Segment
propose.text: Commercial grouping of customers.

propose.title: Term: Credit limit
propose.text: Maximum open receivable for a customer.

propose.title: Term: Overdue
propose.text: Open and past its due date.

propose.title: Term: Discount
propose.text: Percentage off the unit price on an order line.

propose.title: Term: Snapshot
propose.text: A stock count captured for a product on a date.

propose.title: Open invoice balance
propose.text: Total amount of invoices not yet fully paid.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT sum(i.amount) - coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) AS open_balance FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id

propose.title: Monthly revenue
propose.text: Revenue per month from non-cancelled orders.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(l.qty*l.unit_price*(1-l.discount_pct/100)) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1

propose.title: Overdue share
propose.text: Share of open invoice value that is overdue.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < current_date) / nullif(sum(amount),0) AS overdue_share FROM invoices

propose.title: Average order value
propose.text: Mean order value over the last 90 days.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT avg(t) AS aov FROM (SELECT sum(l.qty*l.unit_price) AS t FROM order_lines l GROUP BY l.order_id) x

propose.title: Top customers
propose.text: Top ten customers by revenue.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN sales_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

propose.title: Rep performance
propose.text: Revenue per active rep.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT r.full_name, count(c.id) AS customers FROM sales_reps r LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.rep_id = r.id WHERE r.is_active GROUP BY 1

propose.title: Stock cover
propose.text: Units on hand at the latest snapshot per product.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT p.sku, s.on_hand FROM products p JOIN inventory_snapshots s ON s.product_id = p.id

propose.title: Credit utilisation
propose.text: Open receivable divided by credit limit per customer.

kpis.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, sum(i.amount) / nullif(c.credit_limit,0) AS utilisation FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name, c.credit_limit

watch_candidates.title: Open invoice balance above limit
watch_candidates.condition: Total open invoice balance on public.invoices minus public.payments exceeds 250000

watch_candidates.title: Overdue invoices rising
watch_candidates.condition: Count of invoices where due_date < current_date and not fully paid in public.invoices exceeds 20

watch_candidates.title: Order spike today
watch_candidates.condition: One-shot: alert once when public.sales_orders has more than 100 orders on a single day

watch_candidates.title: Revenue dip
watch_candidates.condition: Daily revenue from public.sales_orders and public.order_lines falls below 60 percent of the 30 day average

watch_candidates.title: Stock out risk
watch_candidates.condition: Products in public.inventory_snapshots with on_hand below 5 on the latest snapshot_date

watch_candidates.title: Credit limit breach
watch_candidates.condition: Customers whose open public.invoices exceed public.customers.credit_limit

watch_candidates.title: Unclear discount spike
watch_candidates.condition: Unclear: average discount_pct in public.order_lines rises sharply

watch_candidates.title: Large single payment
watch_candidates.condition: Any public.payments row with amount above 100000 in the last day
